  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Net flow prints often lead AUM changes, so listed-channel demand shows up in the KPI strip before long-run fund-table balances fully reset. Related: BlackRock's IBIT Captures 72% of $2.8 Billion Bitcoin ETF Inflow Streak - finance.biggo.com (Google News (spot Bitcoin ETF)).

Filing volume does not mean all products launch or scale, but it does point to a heavier near-term slate of spot and spot-adjacent product attempts.
